urls.title: How to configure the URLs
urls.intro1: Using <1>localhost</1> server can only work locally. This is a security measure from modern browsers, <2>HTTPS</2> pages cannot request <3>HTTP</3> URLs.
urls.intro2: In order to use it from the Vercel URL, you have 2 solutions:
urls.solution1: Use your public Ollama (and/or transcription) server URL using <1>HTTPS</1>
urls.solution2: Set your <1>localhost</1> into an <2>HTTPS</2> URL (follow the steps below).
urls.step1Title: Step 1: Get a network URL for your server
urls.step1Text: Use a free private VPN like <1>Tailscale</1> to create an <2>HTTPS</2> URL (e.g. <3>https://YOUR_PRIVATE_URL.ts.net</3>)
urls.step2Text: Use a reverse proxy like <1>Caddy</1>. Create a file <2>Caddyfile</2>, here is an example configuration:
urls.step2Subtext: Go in the folder of the <1>Caddyfile</1> and run <2>caddy run</2>
urls.step3Title: Step 3: Configure Ollama to accept remote connections
urls.step3Text: By default, Ollama only listens for requests on <1>localhost</1>. You must configure 2 variables.
urls.step3Link: How do I configure Ollama .env variables?
urls.step3Var1: Set <1>OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0</1> OR, in Ollama settings, check <2>Expose Ollama to the network</2>
urls.step3Var2: Set <1>OLLAMA_ORIGINS='{{url}}'</1> to accept requests from this URL to prevent CORS errors.
urls.step4Title: Step 4: Use your local <1>HTTPS</1> URLs in the inputs above

image_generation.title: Generate Image
image_generation.prompt_tooltip: The main text prompt to guide the image generation.
image_generation.negative_prompt_tooltip: Text prompt to guide the image generation away from specified concepts.
image_generation.model_tooltip: Select the image generation model to use, and whether to use a refiner model to enhance the generated image quality (only available for SDXL).
image_generation.steps_tooltip: Number of diffusion steps. Higher values generally lead to better quality but take longer.
image_generation.images_tooltip: Number of images to generate per prompt. Limited to 1 for image-to-image.
image_generation.set_image_tooltip: Upload an image to use as a base for image-to-image generation.
image_generation.guidance_scale_tooltip: Controls how strongly the image generation adheres to the prompt. Higher values mean more adherence.
image_generation.denoising_tooltip: Controls the amount of noise added to the input image. Higher values mean more creativity but less resemblance to the original.
image_generation.strength_tooltip: Controls how much the generated image resembles the input image. Only for image-to-image.
